visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: @hahatai_official. [Subtitle]: Has your mental state changed before and after the (Russia-Ukraine) war? 你在 (俄烏) 戰爭前跟戰爭後的 心理狀態有不一樣嗎?. [Slogan]: 安娜/Anna @anna_kompan. (2) [Subtitle]: For a long time we've been dating with my husband for five years before the full escalation of war. 在全面入侵以前 我跟男友交往了五年. (3) [Subtitle]: We were like okay we will find the right time. 我们觉得我们会找到 适当的时间. (4) [Subtitle]: But... When the full escalation of war started. 但... 当全面入侵开始. (5) [Subtitle]: So in 24 hours, you could get married in Ukraine. 所以在24小时内 你就可以在乌克兰结婚. (6) [Subtitle]: That's how we met. 我们就这样遇见了. [Variety]: 哈哈哈哈.
